title: Remove or implement the gh import --force flag
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: `waystation gh import --force` (src/cli/index.ts:1109) is accepted but never passed to `importGitHubIssues` (src/core/gh.ts:132), so the flag is a silent no-op and existing `gh-<number>` issues are always skipped. Decide: implement real overwrite semantics, or remove the flag and document that import is skip-existing-only.
acceptance: `gh import --force` either (a) re-imports/overwrites existing `gh-<number>` records as documented, or (b) is removed from the CLI help and args.
The chosen behavior has a test (CLI help lists the flag iff it is supported).
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
